$ twaco appkey create Acme.Kiosk_AK --user kiosk --expires 2099-01-01 --whitelist 10.0.0.0/8,127.0.0.1
exit: 0

  only from 10.0.0.0/8, 127.0.0.1
  the key would not be printed: `appkey show` reads it later
